nary_nodes.label: 2026 Heatwave in France
evidence: France recorded 5,764 more deaths than usual during a record-breaking heatwave last month, health authorities said on Wednesday, describing the excess mortality among people aged 15 and older as "unprecedented".
The extra deaths between June 17 and July 2 this year were due to "all causes" – none yet clearly linked to the heat, Sante Public France said.
France last month recorded its hottest June since records began in 1947 with a heatwave that saw temperatures spike above 40C in many places.
The average temperatures on June 24 and 25, 2026, were the highest ever recorded in France, all months combined.
nary_nodes.type_justification: The example combines a heatwave with a country and year, requiring a new Event subclass for such natural disaster events.
